anchor: greater of (i) the Series C Preferred Original Issue Price
validating_quote: an amount per share of Series C Preferred equal to the greater of (i) the Series C Preferred Original Issue Price plus all accrued and unpaid dividends, and (ii) the amount such holder would have received if all shares of Preferred Stock had been converted into Common Stock

anchor: greater of (a) the Original Issue Price
validating_quote: an amount per share equal to the greater of (a) the Original Issue Price, plus any dividends declared but unpaid thereon; or (b) such amount per share as would have been payable had all shares of Series A Preferred Stock been converted into Common Stock

anchor: greater of (i) the Maximum Participation Amount
validating_quote: the greater of (i) the Maximum Participation Amount plus any Series A Dividends accrued but unpaid thereon ... and (ii) the amount such holder would have received if all shares of Preferred Stock had been converted into Common Stock
note: TRAP: 'Maximum Participation Amount' implies capped, but MPA is the preference amount and the structure is greater-of => non-participating.

anchor: greater of (x) the Liquidation Preference for the shares of the Series A Preferred Stock
validating_quote: equal to the greater of (x) the Liquidation Preference for the shares of the Series A Preferred Stock ... plus all declared but unpaid dividends ... or (y) such amount per share as would have been payable had all shares of the Series A Preferred Stock been converted into Class B Common Stock

anchor: greater of (x) the Liquidation Preference specified for such share of Series C Preferred
validating_quote: equal to the greater of (x) the Liquidation Preference specified for such share of Series C Preferred ... or (y) such amount per share as would have been payable had all shares of Series C Preferred been converted into Common Stock

anchor: greater of (x) the Liquidation Preference and (y)
validating_quote: an amount of cash per share equal to the greater of (x) the Liquidation Preference and (y) such amount per share as would have been payable had all shares of Series A Preferred Stock been converted into Common Stock

anchor: would receive on an as-converted basis an amount greater than the Liquidation Preference
validating_quote: the remaining assets ... shall be distributed among the holders of shares of any other series of preferred stock ... then to the holders of Common Stock ... if the holders of the Series A Preferred Stock would receive on an as-converted basis an amount greater than the Liquidation Preference, such holders shall be entitled to receive such greater amount
note: After Series A preference, remainder goes to OTHER preferred then common (Series A does not double-dip); Series A gets greater-of => non-participating.

anchor: shall not be entitled to participate in any further distributions
validating_quote: the greater of (i) the Liquidation Preference ... and (ii) if such liquidation ... occurs after the three (3) year anniversary ..., the cash value ... [if] converted ... into shares of Class A Common Stock ... After payment in full of such liquidating distributions, Lincoln shall not be entitled to participate in any further distributions of the remaining assets
note: Conditional as-converted alternative + explicit no-further-participation => non-participating.

anchor: remaining assets of the Corporation available for distribution to its stockholders shall be distributed among the holders of the shares of Preferred Stock and Common Stock
validating_quote: after the payment of all preferential amounts ..., the remaining assets ... shall be distributed among the holders of the shares of Preferred Stock and Common Stock, pro rata based on the number of shares held by each such holder, treating the Preferred Stock on an as-converted basis
note: Flat preference THEN preferred+common share remainder pro rata = participating.

anchor: the remaining assets of the Corporation available for distribution to its stockholders shall be distributed among the holders of the shares of Preferred Stock and Common Stock
validating_quote: after the payment in full of all preferential amounts ... the remaining assets ... shall be distributed among the holders of the shares of Preferred Stock and Common Stock, pro rata based on the number of shares held by each such holder, treating ... [preferred] as-converted
note: Preference (2.1/2.2) then Distribution of Remaining Assets to preferred+common = participating.

anchor: thereafter, the Holders of Preferred Stock shall be entitled to participate with the holders of Common Stock
validating_quote: after payment in full of all amounts payable to the Holders of Preferred Stock ..., (i) the holders of Common Stock shall ... participate ... until [common is caught up] ..., and (ii) thereafter, the Holders of Preferred Stock shall be entitled to participate with the holders of Common Stock, pro-rata on an as-if-converted basis, in the distribution of any remaining assets
note: Preference, common catch-up, then preferred participates with common = participating (with catch-up).

anchor: until the Preferred Stockholders have received 3.5 times
validating_quote: Any remaining assets are to be distributed; 86% to holders of Preferred Stock and 14% to the holders of Common Stock until the Preferred Stockholders have received 3.5 times ($3.50) the aggregate face value of the outstanding Preferred Stock
note: 1x preference then participate (86/14) up to a 3.5x cap = capped participation.

anchor: shall not exceed the Maximum Participation Amount
validating_quote: the assets ... shall be distributed ratably to the holders of the common stock and Series A and Series B preferred stock on an as-if-converted to common stock basis, provided that the aggregate amount which the preferred shareholders are entitled to receive shall not exceed the Maximum Participation Amount
note: Preference then participate, explicitly capped by a Maximum Participation Amount = capped.

validating_quote: if the aggregate amount per share which the holders of Series D Preferred Stock shall be entitled to receive ... shall exceed three (3) times the Series D Preferred Stock Original Issuance Price (the "Participation Cap Amount"), each holder of Series D Preferred Stock shall be entitled to receive ... the greater of (i) the Participation Cap Amount and (ii) the amount such holder would have received if all shares of Series D Preferred Stock had been converted into Class B Common Stock
note: Participating but capped at 3x via a named Participation Cap Amount (greater-of cap-or-converted above the cap).

anchor: until the holders of Series E have received an aggregate of three times
validating_quote: the remaining assets ... distributed ... (assuming full conversion of all such preferred stock) until the holders of Series E have received an aggregate of three times their original issue price, the holders of Series A, B, C, D, and F have received an aggregate of [their per-series caps]
note: Participate after preference UP TO per-series caps (3x for Series E) = capped participation.

anchor: until such time as the holders of Preferred Stock have received
validating_quote: the remaining assets ... will be distributed ratably among the holders of Common Stock and Preferred Stock on an as-converted basis until such time as the holders of Preferred Stock have received ... an aggregate [of three times the Original Issue Price]
note: Preference then participate ratably as-converted, capped at a 3x aggregate = capped.

anchor: the remaining assets of the Company available for distribution will be distributed ratably among the holders of common stock and preferred stock
validating_quote: after [the preferential amounts] have been paid in full, the remaining assets of the Company available for distribution will be distributed ratably among the holders of common stock and preferred stock, on an as-converted basis
note: Flat preference then preferred+common share remainder ratably = participating.

anchor: the remaining assets and funds of the Company available for distribution to shareholders shall be distributed ratably among the holders of Common Stock and Preferred Stock
validating_quote: after ... the preferential amounts so payable to them, the remaining assets and funds of the Company available for distribution to shareholders shall be distributed ratably among the holders of Common Stock and Preferred Stock (on an as-converted-to-common basis)
note: Preference then preferred+common share remainder ratably as-converted = participating.
